desc: Our PROTEUS Series is our most popular pistol offering. This firearm is meant to be the ultimate compact survival gun. The Proteus features a QD removable Barrel system and foldable brace assemble allowing you to transport in a backpack or pistol case. Due to the unique QD Barrel removal system you can also transition between compatible calibers in seconds. Lower Receiver: The Proteus pistol is currently made on our GHOST lowers which we spend the extra time to engrave the serial number on the bottom side of the lower to leave a sleek clean blank finish on the sides to customize to your liking.
